headline: Anthropic Weighs Remaining Private as Window for November IPO Narrows
summary: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic faces a narrowing timeline to file documentation for a prospective November IPO, with portfolio managers noting market pressures may prompt the company to stay private.
why: Anthropic, backed by Amazon and Alphabet, is one of the leading foundational AI model developers; its public listing plans represent a vital gauge of market valuations for generative AI firms.

impacts.name: US Tech IPOs
impacts.why: Delaying or shelving a high-profile AI debut dampens recovery expectations for tech listing volumes.
